title: Miley Cyrus weds Maxx Morando in California, People magazine reports
summary: Grammy-winning pop star Miley Cyrus married her longtime partner, drummer Maxx ‌Morando, in California on Saturday, People magazine and other U.S. entertainment news ​outlets reported.

image.caption: Maxx Morando and Miley Cyrus attend the world premiere for the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special in Los Angeles on March 23. The couple reportedly tied the knot at a ​private ceremony in Palm Springs on Saturday, according U.S. entertainment media outlets. (Mario Anzuoni/Reuters)

blocks.text: Grammy-winning pop star Miley Cyrus married her longtime partner, drummer Maxx ‌Morando, in California on Saturday, People magazine and other U.S. entertainment news ​outlets reported.
The Flowers singer was previously married ​to Australian actor Liam Hemsworth

Cyrus and ​Morando reportedly tied the knot at a ​private ceremony in Palm Springs, ⁠a month ⁠after ‌performing Let's Get Married together at the Hollywood Bowl. The song appears on Cyrus's ⁠latest studio album, Bass Persuades.
Representatives for both Cyrus and ‌Morando did not immediately respond to Reuters's request for comment.
Morando is the ​drummer for Liily, a ⁠Los Angeles-based alternative rock band affiliated ⁠with Atlantic Records, according to ⁠the ⁠band's ​website.
The Flowers singer was previously married ​to Australian actor ⁠Liam Hemsworth, who filed for divorce in Los Angeles in 2019.
